```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
source("config.R") # the profile P (plan section 4); it does not use the RNG
set.seed(P$r$seed)
library(fields)
library(imager)
library(splines)
library(lme4)

# The maps are drawn in the prototype frame (P$prototype: the OLD prototype
# grid and mask for both datasets, A-006)
col_proto <- P$prototype$col_shoe # the number of columns of the prototype
row_proto <- P$prototype$row_shoe # the number of rows of the prototype
proto_rel_col_shoe <- P$prototype$coords$rel_col_shoe
proto_rel_Y_cord <- P$prototype$coords$rel_Y_cord

# The figures of this step, checked before anything is computed: an OLD
# run in place stops here, never over a committed OLD figure (A-075)
cmp_pdf <- vapply(c("pixel_inten_JASAup", "difference_random_cml"),
                  function(s) rac_new_output(P, rac_image_path(P, s)), "")
```

```{r}
# Load models for comparison
# 1. NEW_X_NS_XY (Random Effects Model)
file_name <- rac_model_path(P, "NEW_X_NS_XY")
random_model <- readRDS(file = file_name)

# Get sigma^2 (variance of random effects) from NEW_X_NS_XY
# VarCorr returns standard deviation, so we square it to get variance
sigma_sq <- as.numeric(attr(VarCorr(random_model)$shoe, "stddev"))^2
cat("Random effect variance (sigma^2):", sigma_sq, "\n")
cat("Scaling factor exp(-sigma^2/2):", exp(-sigma_sq/2), "\n")

# 2. CML_MODEL (CML)
file_name <- rac_model_path(P, "CML_MODEL")
cml_model <- readRDS(file = file_name)
```

```{r}
# Load data needed for predictions
file_name <- rac_path(P, "dataCC_distance")
dataCC <- read.csv(file_name, header = TRUE)

xcoor <- t(matrix(rep((-col_proto / 2 + 1:col_proto) * proto_rel_Y_cord / proto_rel_col_shoe, row_proto), col_proto, row_proto))
ycoor <- -matrix(rep((-row_proto / 2 + 1:row_proto) * proto_rel_Y_cord / proto_rel_col_shoe, col_proto), row_proto, col_proto)
xy <- expand.grid(xcoor[1, ], ycoor[, 1]) #col_proto * row_proto
colnames(xy)[colnames(xy) == "Var1"] <- "x"
colnames(xy)[colnames(xy) == "Var2"] <- "y"

img_filled <- t(as.matrix(load.image(rac_path(P, "prototype_mask"))))
```

```{r}
# Calculate intensity for NEW_X_NS_XY (Random Effects Model)
nknotsx <- 3
nknotsy <- 5

# NEW_X_NS_XY uses new_x (standardized x) with splines
knots_new_x <- as.numeric(quantile(dataCC$new_x,1:nknotsx/(1+nknotsx)))
knotsy <-as.numeric(quantile(dataCC$y,1:nknotsy/(1+nknotsy)))
bas_new_x <- ns(dataCC$new_x,knots=knots_new_x)
basy <- ns(dataCC$y,knots=knotsy)

newdesignmat <- rep(1,length(xy$x))
for(i in 1:length(predict(basy,1))) {
  for(j in 1:length(predict(bas_new_x,1))) {
    newdesignmat <-  cbind(newdesignmat,predict(bas_new_x, xy$x)[,j]*predict(basy, xy$y)[,i])  } }

model_coef <- fixef(random_model)
pred.case_control <- newdesignmat%*%model_coef+MEAN_OFFSET

pred.case_control[t(img_filled)==0] <- NA
# Calculate mean of random predictions for use in CML adjustment (like original code line 325)
m <- mean(pred.case_control, na.rm=TRUE)  #for use in the CML

pred.case_control_img <- pred.case_control
prob.pred_random <- exp(matrix(pred.case_control_img ,row_proto,col_proto,byrow=1))/(1+exp(matrix(pred.case_control_img ,row_proto,col_proto,byrow=1)))
intens_random <- -log(1-prob.pred_random) #turning it to intensity
# intens_random is row_proto x col_proto
```

```{r}
# Calculate intensity for CML Model
# CML uses new_x (standardized x), same as NEW_X_NS_XY
knots_new_x_cml <- as.numeric(quantile(dataCC$new_x,1:nknotsx/(1+nknotsx)))
knotsy_cml <-as.numeric(quantile(dataCC$y,1:nknotsy/(1+nknotsy)))
bas_new_x_cml <- ns(dataCC$new_x,knots=knots_new_x_cml)
basy_cml <- ns(dataCC$y,knots=knotsy_cml)

newdesignmat_cml <- rep(1,length(xy$x))
for(i in 1:length(predict(basy_cml,1))) {
  for(j in 1:length(predict(bas_new_x_cml,1))) {
    newdesignmat_cml <-  cbind(newdesignmat_cml,predict(bas_new_x_cml, xy$x)[,j]*predict(basy_cml, xy$y)[,i])  } }

model_coef_cml <- c(0, coef(cml_model))
pred.case_control_cml <- newdesignmat_cml%*%model_coef_cml
pred.case_control_cml[t(img_filled)==0] <- NA

# Mean adjustment on predictions (log-odds scale) - exactly like original code line 354-355
m_1 <- mean(pred.case_control_cml, na.rm=TRUE)
pred.case_control_cml <- pred.case_control_cml - m_1 + m #making the means of random and cml to be equal

pred.case_control_img_cml <- pred.case_control_cml
prob.pred_cml <- exp(matrix(pred.case_control_img_cml ,row_proto,col_proto,byrow=1))/(1+exp(matrix(pred.case_control_img_cml ,row_proto,col_proto,byrow=1)))
intens.pred_cml <- -log(1-prob.pred_cml)
# intens.pred_cml is row_proto x col_proto
```

```{r}
# Figure 2: the 2 estimators intensities on the same scale
sub <- 40
cols <- sub:(col_proto-sub)

# Scale random and CML intensities
# exp(-sigma_sq/2) brings Random & CML down to the marginal scale
intens_random_scaled <- exp(-sigma_sq/2)*intens_random[,cols]
intens_cml_scaled <- exp(-sigma_sq/2)*intens.pred_cml[,cols]

com_2_est <- cbind(intens_random_scaled, intens_cml_scaled)
par(mar = c(2, 0, 0, 4))  # bottom, left, top, right (right margin for color bar)
image.plot(t(com_2_est[nrow(com_2_est):1,]), axes=FALSE, xlab='')
mtext("Random", side=1, at=0.25, line=0.5, cex=2)
mtext("CML", side=1, at=0.75, line=0.5, cex=2)
```

```{r}
pdf(file = cmp_pdf[["pixel_inten_JASAup"]], height=8, width=8)
par(mar = c(2, 0, 0, 4))
image.plot(t(com_2_est[nrow(com_2_est):1,]), axes=FALSE, xlab='')
mtext("Random", side=1, at=0.25, line=0.5, cex=2)
mtext("CML", side=1, at=0.75, line=0.5, cex=2)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# NEW_X_NS_XY (scaled)
intens_random_scaled_sub <- exp(-sigma_sq/2)*intens_random[,cols]
intens_random_display <- t(intens_random_scaled_sub[nrow(intens_random_scaled_sub):1,])
image.plot(intens_random_display, axes=FALSE, main='NEW_X_NS_XY (scaled)')
```

```{r}
# CML_MODEL (scaled)
intens_cml_scaled_sub <- exp(-sigma_sq/2)*intens.pred_cml[,cols]
intens_cml_display <- t(intens_cml_scaled_sub[nrow(intens_cml_scaled_sub):1,])
image.plot(intens_cml_display, axes=FALSE, main='CML_MODEL (scaled)')
```

```{r difference_plot}
# Difference: Random - CML (both on marginal intensity scale)
intens_diff <- intens_random_scaled - intens_cml_scaled
intens_diff_display <- t(intens_diff[nrow(intens_diff):1,])

par(mar = c(2, 0, 1, 4))
image.plot(intens_diff_display, axes=FALSE, main='Difference (Random - CML)')
```

```{r}
pdf(file = cmp_pdf[["difference_random_cml"]], height=8, width=8)
par(mar = c(2, 0, 1, 4))
image.plot(intens_diff_display, axes=FALSE, main='Difference (Random - CML)')
dev.off()

cat("Difference range:", range(intens_diff, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean absolute difference:", mean(abs(intens_diff), na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
```
